title: Does a creature's FREQUENCY weight DF's surface pick, as E36 showed it does underground? Every other land species at frequency 1; KANGAROO and PORCUPINE at the same 4:1 ratio, high (100:25) or low (4:1); both stocked at 500; the surface released every 1,500 ticks.
fork: Surface odds: written to FREQUENCY (it weights the pick) or chosen by the engine (it does not).

predictions.expects: high arm: KANGAROO+PORCUPINE most waves (~86% of weight); low arm: ~20%; ~4:1 between them in both

predictions.model: the surface ignores frequency (E3's weight is something else)
predictions.expects: the same share in both arms

kill_criterion: the pair's share of waves differs by less than 20 points between the arms in both replicate pairs
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
a replicate with fewer than 12 waves is thin

arms.name: high
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disarmed')

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local want={}; for _,t in ipairs({'KANGAROO','PORCUPINE'}) do want[t]=true end; local n=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(pop.race); if cr and want[cr.creature_id] and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) then pop.quantity=500; pop.flags.extinct=false; n=n+1 end end; print(('x: %d entries stocked at 500'):format(n))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local land={}; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) and df.world_population_type[pop.type]=='Animal' then land[pop.race]=true end end; local n,o=0,0; for i,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if false then elseif cr.creature_id=='KANGAROO' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif cr.creature_id=='PORCUPINE' then cr.frequency=25; n=n+1 elseif land[i] then cr.frequency=1; o=o+1 end end; print(('x: %d named species set, %d other land species at frequency 1'):format(n,o))
